title: Conflicts of interest register
rule: No one may adjudicate a claim, measurement or complaint concerning an organisation that employs them, funds them, or that they advise. A conflicted person is replaced and the replacement is recorded.
why_published: A body that publishes states about named organisations must publish who decides. An empty register and an unappointed panel are different facts; this file states which is true.

current_status.note: No independent adjudicator has been appointed and no declaration has been collected as at 2026-10-31. The register is published in that state rather than left blank.

roles.role: Adjudicator — claims register and Watchdog daily report
roles.confers: May change the recorded state of a third-party claim, with a published reason.
roles.may_not_decide: Any claim concerning an organisation that employs, funds or advises the holder.

roles.role: Adjudicator — measurement disputes and axis promotion
roles.confers: May accept or reject a measured result for publication on the board.
roles.may_not_decide: Any axis where the holder's own work, models or employer is a subject.

roles.confers: Decides complaints under /complaints/ within the published service levels.
roles.may_not_decide: A complaint about a decision the holder made.
Any case in which the holder took part at first instance.

roles.confers: Publishes, deploys and signs under owner authority.
roles.may_not_decide: The measurement result of an axis on which CSOAI's own models are a subject; own models are excluded from comparisons and first-party claims are held to the same statement rules as third-party claims.

recusal.trigger: A relevant interest in the subject, its funders, or its competitors.
procedure: declare in writing to this register
reassign the case to an unconflicted adjudicator
record the reassignment and its reason
if no unconflicted adjudicator exists, publish DEFERRED — no unconflicted adjudicator and do not decide
recusal.retention: A declaration remains published while the interest exists and is retained after it ends.

declaration_schedule.annual: within 30 days of the anniversary of appointment
declaration_schedule.per_case: a case-specific check at the start of any adjudication

funding_disclosure.rule: Funding is disclosed in aggregate. No funder may direct a state, a rank, a delay or the removal of a correction.
funding_disclosure.note: No payer is named without written consent.

reporting.quarterly: complaints received, grounds accepted and rejected, conflicts declared, cases reassigned, cases deferred
reporting.annual: the full register with retention history

corrections.rule: An error in this register is corrected by a new entry citing the old one; entries are never silently edited.
